in_marathi.name: Pragnesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pragnesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pragnesh is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'prag' meaning 'desire' and 'nesh' meaning 'satisfaction'. This name suggests one who is deeply desirous and longs for fulfillment and satisfaction.
